description: Source code for Unicode normalization functions in the 'norm' package, including types, constants, and methods for normalizing Unicode strings and bytes, checking normalization, and handling boundaries.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Type representing Unicode normalization forms (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD).

classes.name: reorderBuffer
classes.description: Struct used internally for reordering and normalizing Unicode segments.

classes.name: formInfo
classes.description: Struct containing information about Unicode normalization segments.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Type representing properties of Unicode runes used in normalization.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Returns the normalized form of a byte slice.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the normalized form of a string.

methods.name: IsNormal
methods.description: Checks if a byte slice is already normalized.

methods.name: IsNormalString
methods.description: Checks if a string is already normalized.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends normalized bytes to an existing byte slice.

methods.name: AppendString
methods.description: Appends normalized string bytes to an existing byte slice.

methods.name: QuickSpan
methods.description: Returns a boundary index where normalization can be safely split.

methods.name: Span
methods.description: Implements transform.SpanningTransformer to find normalization boundary.

methods.name: SpanString
methods.description: Returns a boundary index for a string where normalization can be split.

methods.name: FirstBoundary
methods.description: Returns the first boundary position in a byte slice.

methods.name: FirstBoundaryInString
methods.description: Returns the first boundary position in a string.

methods.name: NextBoundary
methods.description: Returns the index of the next boundary in a byte slice.

methods.name: NextBoundaryInString
methods.description: Returns the index of the next boundary in a string.

methods.name: lastRuneStart
methods.description: Finds the start of the last rune in a buffer.

methods.name: decomposeToLastBoundary
methods.description: Finds and scans the last open segment at the end of a buffer.
